name: matrix
description: Connect enabled Xedoc sessions to private Matrix rooms used from Element.

commands.name: matrix
commands.description: Manage Matrix bridge status, setup, lifecycle debugging, and help with /matrix.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Xedoc sessions to Matrix for bidirectional messaging.
interface.longDescription: Matrix creates one private room for each approved Xedoc root session, forwards Xedoc and Element messages bidirectionally without echoing Matrix input, and reports bridge lifecycle and failures to Xedoc.
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect this Xedoc session to Matrix.
